decisive_items: Shows a compound nevus with large nested melanocytes and bridging at the dermal-epidermal junction consistent with an atypical compound nevus
Score: -7.1 (where scores from -16.7 to -2.1 are consistent with a benign nevus)
Epidermolysis Bullosa Nevus at 9 Years of Age
response.rationale: Histopathology and gene expression testing explicitly support a benign atypical compound nevus, while the melanoma candidate relies on isolated atypia contradicted by the benign gene expression score and overall histopathologic interpretation.

rejected.why: Gene expression score is in the benign range and histopathology is consistent with atypical compound nevus, not melanoma.
